notes.title: Update Notice 11-30
notes.notes:
1. Fixed bugs about the 'Fullscreen'.
2. Added "Money" to buy "table lamps"， Key '1' is the hot key for shopping.
3. you can pick plankton and 'Space Key' is  the hot key for your collections.

I believe this game should belong to 'idle game' class, 
I would like to add some art effects and puzzle elements.

Enjoy it.
